name: A + B
description: You are given two integers A and B . Calculate their sum and output it without leading zeros.
input_specification: Two lines of input data contain integers A and B ( 1 ≤ A , B ≤ 10 5 ).
output_specification: Output A + B without leading zeros.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
